cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Wait before you go. You said our wedding venue was booked for Friday. This says Monday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Monday was cheaper. Can you sign? I'm late for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Stay while I read it. You told me Friday was confirmed.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It was. I moved it after we sent the invitations.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then work needs to wait. Explain when you planned to tell the Friday guests.

mechanism: A supervises correction of conflicting wedding documents to make B account for the withheld booking change.
confusable: Ordinary outrage would protest the new date; S03 must organize the correction and reject faulty process.
comparison: Shared financial/date decisions differ from the taxi scene's personal whereabouts.
seedUse: Use the mismatched invitation and booking; connect S03 to consent and document correction.
